  tool call for risky
  actions and prompt
  injection before
  executing. Actions
  Claude identifies as
  safe are executed,
  while actions Claude
  identifies as risky

  Claude may try a
  different approach.
  Ideal for
  long-running tasks.
  Claude can make
  mistakes that allow
  harmful commands to
  run, it's
